integrity: Exact theorem proved without experimental extrapolation; an independent finite verifier is included. Priority and proof have not received independent expert validation.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled open path ladders of width two, ordinary minimal domination, and their maximum-cardinality layer. Not an all-cardinality polynomial; no cyclic or wider-grid extension. Prior work may imply an equivalent specialized characterization.
title: Rigidity and exact multiplicity of upper-dominating sets in open ladders
